the first measurement pass compiled the requirement vocabulary with Python `\b` boundaries, which treat `_` as a word character and therefore CANNOT see separator-joined compound identifiers such as `target_large_move_7d`, `profit_optimized_threshold` or `exchange_netflow_btc` - the exact shapes a real feature panel or on-chain column set uses. That pass was withdrawn rather than quietly reported, and every number in this snapshot comes from the boundary-aware re-measurement (`_boundary_aware`: lookarounds that treat `_`, `-` and `.` as separators while still refusing ordinary English, e.g. `determining` does not match `mining`). Under the stronger probe the raw-side result is unchanged - 0 decisive tokens by name or payload, 0 decisive group carried by any row shape - and the host-side hit structure is unchanged (same store-shaped hits, 0 unclassified, no decisive series-shaped row); the superseded measurement is preserved at `.kanban-scratch/t_79e9c694/measure_all_wordboundary_v1.json` and the probe change is regression-checked by the round's own `--raw-fixture-control`

contract 13 has no dedicated prerequisite-missing class; `data_window_invalid` is used as the closest registered card-local class, and the §6.4 prerequisite-missing alignment bullet (card t_2acfd339) explicitly makes this honest TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE the terminal. Unlike the sibling carry-wedge card, the calendar windows here DO partially overlap (1461 of 2891 registered sample days), so the terminal is primarily a modality absence - two of the record's three feature channels (on-chain, sentiment) have 0 occurrences tree-wide - plus the record's own unspecified feature construction, and it is stated that way in both artifacts

the record is a multi-modal deep-learning signal (Multi-Scale TCN over on-chain + market + sentiment) whose own Limitations and Crypto-portability paragraphs register the exact feature set, the specific on-chain metrics, the sentiment source and the profit-optimization procedure as underspecified; both readings (data absent / specification absent) are registered and neither was resolved by inventing features

the market modality IS present locally, as a single-venue USDT-quoted USD-M perpetual at daily bars (BTCUSDT 2022-01-01 -> 2026-09-16), which the record's own 'venue not specified' / 'spot or perpetual (not specified)' latitude admits; the round registers it as a local analogue rather than claiming it satisfies the record's on-chain-coupled data expectation

the inherited USER_FIXED execution envelope (linear USD-M perp, 10x, 12-tranche geometric DCA ladder) is written for a perpetual book while this record's signal is a daily long-only model output with no locally constructible feature set; the tension is recorded in `execution_invariants_disclosure` and not resolved by inventing a mapping

the card's falsification excerpt carries the record's items 1-5 behind an explicit '_（節錄；完整內容見 canonical record）_' marker while the record registers 6 items (item 6 = feature ablation); the full battery is carried verbatim in the round-spec, none lowered and none removed, and the card-vs-record difference is disclosed rather than papered over
